name: Activity Timeline
description: Every record of the agent's transcript on one time axis. A time range selector holds the whole run and frames the part the lanes and the list show. The lanes are grouped by the Rows control (the tactic label where it has run, so the long stretches of captcha-solving, account sign-up and money-hunting stand apart from the thin sliver of exploit work at the very end, else a field such as Tool), colored by the Color by control and filtered by the Filter by control, all in the top row; Events draws each record as a mark, Density each lane as bars on the range's bins. The context compaction is a flag on the axis, and a record opens in the side panel with a button that opens the transcript at that message.

accepts.means: the record on line <n>, or the nearest, opened in the list

units.means: the record with that index, opened in the list

records.name: record
records.one: one transcript message — a piece of reasoning or a tool call with its result

fields.name: time
fields.how: read in UTC, and for the system prompt and the two context-compaction turns, whose stamp is the harness clock rather than a point in the run, taken from the records around them in file order

fields.name: tool
fields.how: the tool a ToolMessage called, read as the file holds it; Reasoning for a message with no tool call

fields.name: role
fields.how: System, Assistant or Human, read as the file holds it
